parentTask: FOCUS-YTM-4 — device report round 2: signed in, search OK, track visible in Now Playing but never plays, duration '--:--', NO error shown

qa.deviceTests: NOT RUN in sandbox; v1.4.2 turns the stuck shape into a visible typed message whose TEXT identifies the root cause (user relays it)

evidenceAndAnalysis.screenshot: upload/Screenshot_20261013_181427_Ridho Music.png — track+artwork render (timeline has items), duration '--:--' (= TIME_UNSET, never READY), play button idle, NO error banner
evidenceAndAnalysis.media3SourcesVerified: media3-session 1.5.1 sources (Google Maven) — per-controller command queue serializes setMediaItems(resolution)→prepare→play (ConnectedControllersManager.flushCommandQueue waits on each command's future); controller timeline updates only from session events. Media3 ordering is NOT the bug.
evidenceAndAnalysis.conclusion: The failure shape is: items reached the timeline but audio never started and no error event ever fired. v1.4.1's watchdog wrongly equated 'items in timeline' with success and stopped watching — the last silent path.

changes: PlaybackRepository watchdog v2: success = pending track is CURRENT and player READY/playing (play) or the item exists in the resolved timeline (addToQueue — semantics split via pendingIsAddToQueue); at the 15s deadline it distinguishes KIND_STALLED (items present, audio never started, safe player-state diagnostic: state/queue/bufferedMs/durationMs) from KIND_TIMEOUT (no answer at all)
PlaybackRepository: play() clears lastError up front (fresh attempt, honest UI)

PlaybackService: one-shot post-resolution kick (800 ms): prepares+plays ONLY when playWhenReady && items>0 && state IDLE/ENDED && duration unset — the wedged shape; guarded against every legitimate state

PlaybackService: recovery-once-per-media-id guard with retainAll-on-transition (our own replaceMediaItem fires a transition, so the marker for the CURRENT id must survive — otherwise the 403 re-resolve loop re-arms)
PlaybackErrorInfo: KIND_STALLED; PlaybackErrorText: STALLED → err_playback_stalled (new string, honest wording + Open-in-YouTube-Music hint)
